meta.description: delv. helps healthtech companies define, measure and articulate value, so their claims stand up to procurement, investors and regulators.

blocks.name: Hero
blocks.heading: Prove the value.Prove your why.
sub: We know that you believe in your product; it’s likely your team, investors, and end users do too. Sadly, vanity metrics and surface-level data aren’t beneficial if you cannot show the evidence of value and impact.
We help healthtech companies define, measure and articulate value, so you can replace the nice qualitative statements with the hard metrics and evidence that help you grow.

strong.label: After
strong.text: Saved 2 minutes per consultation, releasing 500 clinician hours every week.

claim.caption: Illustrative figures, not a client result.

blocks.name: Move on from warm fuzzy feelings
blocks.heading: Move on from warm fuzzy feelings
paragraphs: Measuring success in downloads, seats, sessions, likes and registrations only proves that somebody turned your product on. It’s the “what”, not the “why”. These don’t win procurement points, justify investment or increase an exit valuation.

Organisations of all sizes have to prove ROI, value and impact: for themselves, for their clients and their users. A warm quote might land well, but it doesn’t move the commercial needle. For that, it’s about minutes, money and metrics now more than ever.
blocks.muted: We sit between the economists and the optimists, finding the right balance of value to help you find and talk about numbers that your buyer can believe in, that remove barriers to purchase, and make you indispensable.

blocks.name: Sound familiar?
blocks.heading: Sound familiar?
items: Your marketing claims don’t set you apart from the competition.
You keep losing prospect deals when scored on impact ratings.
You have signed a risk-sharing contract that requires real-world evidence.
Sales, product, data and clinical all speak about value differently.
You have a bunch of claims but no way of auditing, managing, or quality checking them.
You’re claiming “proven” based on deployment, not proof.

blocks.name: A simple approach for complicated subjects.
blocks.heading: A simple approach for complicated subjects.

items.heading: Define
items.body: What value means here: to you, to your buyers, and to whoever holds the purse strings. We audit the claims you already make, decide which are worth proving, and highlight gaps and opportunities.

items.heading: Measure
items.body: Financial, operational and clinical impact, built from the data you have, or from data we work with your teams to acquire. We help you build a standardised and systematic approach to value and ROI.

items.heading: Articulate
items.body: Stats, facts, ROI measures, publishable evidence: we convert the numbers into high-impact differentiators, with disclaimers, references, and rules for how each claim can be used.

blocks.name: We have been on your side of the table
blocks.heading: We have been on your side of the table

figure.label: A procurement or business case meeting from the seller side of the table. Documents and a screen with numbers on it, faces not required.

paragraphs: Between us we have been a practising GP, a medical director inside a fast-scaling digital health company, and the person responsible for making a healthtech vendor’s value story stand up in NHS procurement. We have written the claim, found the data that did not support it, and gone back to rebuild it.

The other half of the job is knowing where the number has to land. We know how the NHS buys, who signs a business case off and at what level, and how the same argument has to be rebuilt for a health system in another country, where the payer, the budget and the evidence bar are all different.

blocks.name: Closing call to action
blocks.heading: We don’t just write your value story; we help you build the book.
